outcome: weight for age Z score (WAZ) change from birth to 6 months
cohort: A multi-racial birth cohort of primarily Latinx mothers and newborns recruited at two San Francisco hospitals (N=330).
finding: Pre-existing and/or gestational hypertension was associated with rapid infant weight gain (RIWG) and weight for age Z score (WAZ) change, and longer leukocyte telomere length (LTL) at birth was positively associated with WAZ score change.
